Cc: procurement@satelliteworks.com

Subject: SatelliteWorks trial onboarding — PO requirement question

Hi Marcus and Laura,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — the team is excited to kick off a 6-week pilot. Quick question on onboarding: our finance team usually issues a PO for vendor engagements, but the pilot is small and time-sensitive. Is there flexibility for a one-time allowlist / invoice-only path so we can get started this week?

If needed, I can send over our W-9 and insurance cert. Also attaching a one-page scope and estimated spend (~$1,200 for the pilot).

What would work from Redwood's side to start the pilot without a full PO in place?

Best,
Elena

elena@satelliteworks.com

Subject: Re: SatelliteWorks trial onboarding — PO requirement question

Hi Elena — great to meet you today and glad the pilot looks like a fit. We can often accommodate small, time-bound pilots on an invoice-only path using a temporary allowlist, provided we get a short evidence bundle (W-9, insurance, and estimated spend) and procurement signs the PO-exception form.

Karthik (cc'd) is the procurement lead. Karthik — can you confirm what minimum evidence you need to approve a one-off invoice route for a sub-$5k pilot? If we can get a quick approval, Laura and I will prepare the invoice and pilot kickoff checklist.

Elena — I'll add our standard trial terms and a blank PO-Exception-Form for signatures. If procurement requires formal PO later, we can convert the pilot spend into the PO and issue a credit.

Next steps:
- Elena: share W-9 + insurance (if available)
- Karthik: advise required evidence and sign-off path
- Marcus/Laura: prepare invoice and kickoff calendar once approved

Thanks,
Marcus
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SatelliteWorks trial onboarding — PO requirement question

Marcus / Laura,

Thanks for the ping. Policy recap: our default is PO-first for vendor onboarding. That said, Procurement can approve a temporary invoice-only arrangement for pilots under $5,000 on a case-by-case basis if the following conditions are met:

1) Signed PO-Exception-Form (attached).
2) W-9 on file for the vendor.
3) Proof of commercial general liability insurance (or waiver documented).
4) Single invoice that lists pilot scope and total not to exceed the stated estimate.

If all four are satisfied, Procurement will add SatelliteWorks to the temporary allowlist for up to 90 days and flag Finance to process a direct invoice. We will require sign-off from a Procurement Manager (Laura) and Finance (billing@redwoodinference.com) for any exceptions above $2,500.

I attached the PO-Exception-Form and added inline fields for spend ceiling and evidence checklist. Note: if the pilot converts to a subscription, we'll need a normal PO and contract routing.

Attachment: PO-Exception-Form.pdf

--
